offer_terms.claim_guidance: Use 'about 50% less than monthly Pro' or show $149/mo versus $75/mo billed annually. Do not call this 50% off the standard annual price.

testing_rules.hero_set: Test the five standalone mobile heroes against one another.
testing_rules.carousel_set: Test the five three-card carousel stories against one another.
guardrails: Keep audience, placement, bid strategy, destination and schedule identical within each format.
Run every creative in the same 4:5 mobile placement.
Do not compare hero and carousel results until both format sets clear the conversion floor.
Pause all offer creatives immediately if Founding Pro terms change.

hero_creatives.hypothesis: The market-behind-the-stock promise will communicate product breadth while a single Prophet card keeps the outcome concrete.
hero_creatives.primary_text: Don’t just trade the ticker. Trade the market behind it—with entry and risk mapped.
hero_creatives.headline: Trade the market behind the stock.

hero_creatives.hypothesis: A three-stage context-to-plan visual will make the transformation from information overload to an executable trade clearest.
hero_creatives.primary_text: Turn market noise into one ranked stock signal, exact entry zone and invalidation.
hero_creatives.headline: The market is noisy. Your trade plan shouldn’t be.

hero_creatives.hypothesis: A large real Terminal crop plus an actionable signal overlay will distinguish MastermindX from chart-only products.
hero_creatives.primary_text: Your chart shows what happened. See what to do next—with market context built in.
hero_creatives.headline: A browser Terminal with the intelligence layer built in.

hero_creatives.hypothesis: Showing the evidence read before the answer will make Mastermind AI feel materially different from ticker-only chat.
hero_creatives.primary_text: Ask about a stock. Get the market around it—then the setup, entry and risk.
hero_creatives.headline: AI that reads the whole market before it answers.

hero_creatives.hypothesis: A concise call paired with three visible reasons will build more trust than a black-box buy or sell label.
hero_creatives.primary_text: Every stock signal should show its work: market case, entry and invalidation.
hero_creatives.headline: Every stock signal should show its work.

carousel_creatives.hypothesis: Separating the promise, four market forces and offer will preserve the complete product story without shrinking its proof.
carousel_creatives.primary_text: Trade the market behind the stock. Swipe to see what one ranked signal carries.
carousel_creatives.headline: Trade the market behind the stock.

carousel_creatives.hypothesis: A process story will convert information overload into a visible before-and-after outcome over three cards.
carousel_creatives.primary_text: Market noise in. One ranked signal, exact entry and invalidation out.
carousel_creatives.headline: The market is noisy. Your trade plan shouldn’t be.

carousel_creatives.hypothesis: A full-card real Terminal view followed by the intelligence layer will show the product difference better than a generic browser mockup.
carousel_creatives.primary_text: Your chart shows what happened. MastermindX shows what to watch next—and why.
carousel_creatives.headline: A real Terminal with the intelligence layer built in.

carousel_creatives.hypothesis: A promise-answer-reasoning sequence will prove that Mastermind AI synthesizes market evidence rather than returning generic ticker commentary.
carousel_creatives.primary_text: Ask about a stock. Get the market around it—then the setup, entry and risk.
carousel_creatives.headline: AI that reads the whole market before it answers.

carousel_creatives.hypothesis: A proof-led sequence that exposes the evidence behind the call will increase trust among skeptical active investors.
carousel_creatives.primary_text: Every stock signal should show its work. Swipe from the call to the receipts.
carousel_creatives.headline: Every stock signal should show its work.
